Priya Das: Hi team, onboarding question. My spouse is on my plan but doesn't have a US SSN (we just moved from India). I uploaded our marriage certificate but Rippling asks for SSN for dependent verification. What docs do you need and will this affect payroll/tax withholdings?

Maya (People Ops): Welcome, @Priya! If your spouse doesn't have an SSN, we accept alternative proof: marriage certificate + spouse passport page + visa/I-94 or an affidavit. Upload under Documents > Category: Benefits > Subtype: Dependent proof and tick Share with Benefits Team. We'll flag it for manual review.

Priya Das: Thanks. Do you have an example filename or required fields on the affidavit?

Luca (HR Systems): Filename doesn't matter but we recommend: `priya_das_spouse_docs.pdf`. For the affidavit, a simple signed statement listing spouse name, DOB, relationship, and reason SSN unavailable works. Include contact info and a photocopy of passport.

Luca (HR Systems): Steps: ```Rippling > Documents > Add Document > Category: Benefits > Subtype: Dependent proof > Upload files > Share with Benefits Team```

Benefits Bot: Document bundle received. Ticket #BZ-7128. Status: pending manual review.

Jordan (Payroll): Heads-up: dependent coverage itself doesn't change federal tax withholdings automatically. If you add a household member for benefits, it can affect your pre-tax deductions (medical/dental/FSAs) which lower taxable wages. If you have questions about tax implications (e.g., whether to update W-4), we can route to payroll advisory.

Priya Das: OK. For FSA, I enrolled during hire. Will dependent dental be eligible immediately once verified?

Maya (People Ops): Yes, because adding a spouse within the initial enrollment window is allowed. If verification completes within 30 days of your hire/enrollment date, coverage is effective retroactive to enrollment date. If it's after, it may be treated as a QLE and we handle accordingly. We'll mark the ticket for expedited review given international docs.

Priya Das: Appreciate it. How long does manual review usually take?

Benefits Bot: Ticket #BZ-7128 updated: flagged for international documentation review. Estimated processing: 2-3 business days.

Jordan (Payroll): Once verified, payroll will show a deduction line like "Dental - EE + Dependent"; timing depends on verification date vs payroll cycle. DM me your pay period end date if you want me to confirm the exact paycheck.

Priya Das: Re-uploaded bundle as `priya_das_spouse_docs.pdf` and included an affidavit. Thanks for the quick replies.

Maya (People Ops): Got it. We'll follow up on the ticket. If anything blocks verification (e.g., unclear passport scan), we'll request a clearer copy. Ping me if you don't see status change in 72 hours. :slightly_smiling_face:
